notes.title: Pyxel Knight 10/12/2020 Update
notes.content:
Thank you for all the bug reports. I'm actively making fixes to them as I can find them. 

I've fixed a bug report on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/652940/discussions/0/2933490248148620814/]bug board[/url] from svenevil about only being able to move left / right but nothing else. I've fixed this by making the starting power-ups be Walk, Jump and Sword Attack. This means you will no longer have to get the jump power up and the sword power up before you can use them. In the future I'm going to make it so Campaigns can customize what power ups the player starts with. For now though it will be the previously mentioned Walk, Jump and Sword Attack.

I've also had a bug report from a player Vazor, [i]When I went to make a new character I put the name in and then when I clicked Confirm it turned green but then didn't go back to the previous menu and there was no button to go back that I could find so I got stuck and had to force close the game.[/i] This one has not been resolved. I've not been able to pin down why this is happening. The biggest problem here is I've not been able to reproduce the problem. It's the classic "It's working on my machine" problem. I'm going to test my game on a couple of other computers I have access to and see if I can get the problem to happen.

Past the bug reports I've improved the power up equip screen and ability equip screen to be more user intuitive.

notes.title: Pyxel Knight 10/7/2020 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The latest update address several bugs that have been reported and has changed one core feature.
Pyxel Knight will no longer be using Badges and Badge Points. In their place will be Power Ups and Power Crystals. Functionally they will work about the same but now Power Crystals will float around in the scene. Players have requested this change so that they can more quickly understand the feature.

There has also been an update to the Player Menu that updates all the images used and now provides a cleaner layout to activate power ups.
